verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Studio as an interface for testing agents, workflows, and tools. Separately, it says Mastra can build MCP servers and has an MCP client. No item documents a browser-based inspector or playground for connecting to an MCP server and exercising its tools before integration. Studio's general tool testing is an adjacent feature, so it earns no credit for this MCP-specific story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can exercise an MCP server's tools from a browser-based inspector or playground before integrating it
